    Chains of arrows out of a point, minimal for the Dershowitz–Manna order #

    BChain c P α β is a walk of links between arrows out of c, each link a nonzero common upper bound with target in P. Among chains between two arrows we take one whose multiset of bound depths is minimal for the Dershowitz–Manna order (exists_minC). Every contiguous piece of a minimal chain is minimal; a minimal link joins distinct arrows (IsMinC.ne), and two minimal consecutive links satisfy the valley condition at their common arrow (IsMinC.valley).
